nodes.label: mimir main()
nodes.desc: Binary entrypoint (main, L82) that assembles all components; monolithic mode runs them in one process.

nodes.label: Distributor.Push
nodes.desc: Stateless write front-end (Push, L2284) validating and forwarding remote-write requests to ingesters.

nodes.label: HA dedup middleware
nodes.desc: prePushHaDedupeMiddleware (L28) picks a dedupe strategy so replicated Prometheus replicas collapse into one sample stream.

nodes.label: Ingester.PushWithCleanup
nodes.desc: Per-tenant write path (PushWithCleanup, L217) that batches samples into TSDB appenders.

nodes.label: userTSDB
nodes.desc: One TSDB per tenant (Appender, L205; Compact, L238) with WAL and in-memory head.

nodes.label: shipper.Sync
nodes.desc: Uploads compacted block directories to the bucket (Sync, L108).

nodes.label: StoreGateway
nodes.desc: Ring-sharded read service (syncStores, L396; Series, L408) owning a subset of tenants' blocks.

nodes.label: BucketStore
nodes.desc: Reads blocks straight from object storage (NewBucketStore, L203; Series, L577).

nodes.label: MultitenantCompactor
nodes.desc: Sharded service (NewMultitenantCompactor, L380) that plans and runs per-tenant compactions.

nodes.label: BucketCompactor
nodes.desc: Executes compaction jobs against the bucket (runCompactionJob, L257).

nodes.label: BlocksCleaner
nodes.desc: Prunes deleted tenants and obsolete blocks (cleanUser, L452).

nodes.label: TSDB blocks
nodes.desc: Parquet-free TSDB block directories (chunks, index, meta.json) persisted in S3/GCS/Azure for long-term storage.
